implementation_updates: GitHubClient.tree supports recursive and non-recursive requests.
Truncated recursive trees trigger bounded directory traversal with max_tree_entries=50000 and max_tree_directories=10000.
Reports distinguish recursive truncation, recovery attempted/completed, directories visited and entries seen.
Three new regression tests cover successful recovery, directory-cap incompleteness and truncated subtree incompleteness.
Research Mission Form now submits to local-only HTTP API and queues validated mission JSON in SQLite.
Mission validator enforces strict field allowlists, independent reviewer inclusion and immutable research-only safety policy.
Mission queue uses thread-safe SQLite access for concurrent HTTP worker threads.
Mission API end-to-end tests and safety rejection tests added.
Added a loopback-only OpenAI-compatible model adapter with structured JSON output, bounded responses, timeout, explicit model identity, and redirect blocking; no cloud or paid fallback.
Added specialist role prompts and a provenance gate that accepts only exact source signals present in the pinned inspection report.
Added deterministic specialist-report provenance validation before independent reviewer tasks.
Integrated local semantic task stages into mission execution when both local endpoint and model name are explicitly configured.
Mission finalization now preserves failed and dependency-blocked task states instead of incorrectly marking the mission completed.
Main graph now invokes the local semantic specialist/evidence/reviewer stage after commit-pinned source capture; regression test asserts stage order and checkpoint output.

Independent reviewer now receives actual completed candidate-purpose and specialist report content, with role and inspected-commit provenance checks.

no_drift_guard: Mission is to discover public GitHub repositories across flash loans, flash-loan liquidation, DeFi liquidators, lending protocols, arbitrage, MEV and adjacent infrastructure.
For each repository, determine actual purpose, what code does, completeness, correctness, security, economics, tests, dependencies and license from commit-pinned evidence.
Mission Form is the primary user interface; no manual prompting of individual agents as the normal workflow.
Taxonomy-driven discovery is one stage of the autonomous swarm, never the final product.
Do not claim all public repositories have been found; quantify search coverage and API/indexing limitations.
Candidate code is never executed; no wallets, keys, signing, deployment, broadcast or live trading.
No paid services or paid inference fallback; model-dependent work blocks explicitly if free local inference is unavailable.
All material findings require source provenance and independent review before accepted.
